title: Configurational Taxonomy of Planetary Bodies: A Fuzzy-Set QCA of Orbital Hierarchy, Dynamical Dominance, Composition, and Evolution
domain: planetary science / comparative methods / set-theoretic analysis / taxonomy
summary: Primary M2 remains frozen and calibration closed. Evidence readiness now passes both ATMOSPHERE_RETENTION and INTERNAL_ORGANIZATION at 40/50 each. Complete cases are 27/50; the only dominant readiness failure is the missing 16-case small-body numeric layer that keeps SCALE, BULK_MATERIAL and SOLAR_ENERGY at 34/50.

aris.provenance: All evidence and readiness gates were frozen/updated before calibration or QCA exposure. Batch 08 uses explicit NASA airless-asteroid evidence and direct stellar-occultation upper limits; no atmosphere absence is inferred from silence.
